focus.name: interaction-spawn-type79-type7a-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the four Type-0x79/0x7A scene-interaction handlers to stable creation identities while retaining selector-qualified historical names.

gates: The handlers retain their established allocation-success checks before post-allocation AnimationVM root writes.
contracts: Selectors 0x0A-0x0C reverse-spawn the Type-0x79 interaction template and install AnimationVM root 0x00125A4C.
Selectors 0x06, 0x07, and 0x08 use the Type-0x7A interaction template through the backward-slot helper and install roots 0x00125A68, 0x00125A88, and 0x00125AA8 respectively.
evidence: Exact handler bodies and INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE membership
Established Type-0x79/0x7A templates, allocator contracts, and per-selector AnimationVM roots
limitations: The names identify exact runtime types and AnimationVM variants, not user-facing scene roles.
Dynamic reachability of the six selectors remains unresolved.
